description: Check whether a visa is required and what rule applies for a traveller nationality visiting a destination. Use this first for questions like 'Do I need a visa?' before listing or comparing products.

destination.description: Destination country ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 or alpha-3 code.

language.description: Optional ISO 639-1 language code for localized fields.

nationality.description: Traveller nationality ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 or alpha-3 code.

name: get_visa_requirements
